item.title: Iran, four other countries condemn US plans to deploy weapons in outer space
item.description: Iran, China, Russia, Belarus and Cuba are warning that the move poses a serious threat to international peace and security and risks escalating the militarization of space.

item.title: North Khorasan: land of opportunities
item.description: North Khorasan is more than a passage to a religious destination; it has a distinctive culture, productive farmlands, established industries, and landscapes with tourism Potential.

item.title: Hezbollah: Iranian stance a key factor of strength in Lebanon’s hands
item.description: A senior Hezbollah official says Tehran’s unwavering support for Lebanon deserves gratitude from both the Lebanese government and nation.

item.title: Speaker Ghalibaf: Iran now determines the geography of the battlefield
item.description: Iran's Parliament speaker says the country has emerged stronger from recent wars, stressing that military strength, economic resilience, diplomacy and national unity are essential to deterring future aggression.

item.title: Iran condemns Bahrain's 'baseless accusations,' exposes role in US aggression
item.description: Tehran tells the UN Security Council that Bahrain cannot escape responsibility for allowing its territory and military facilities to be used in aggression against Iran.

item.title: Three oil tankers catch fire after hitting naval mines in Strait of Hormuz: IRGC Navy
item.description: The IRGC Navy warns shipping companies against violating maritime regulations and ignoring navigation warnings.

item.title: Imposing land blockade on Iran ‘almost impossible’: Araghchi
item.description: Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi says the idea of imposing a land blockade on Iran is untenable.

item.title: 4th Sobh International Media Festival opens call for entries
item.description: The Sobh International Media Festival, a prestigious media event in Iran, has opened its call for submissions for the fourth edition.

item.title: Iranian courts demand US pay $290 billion in damages
item.description: The head of the Judiciary’s Center for Lawyers, Official Experts and Family Counselors says Iran's legal process against hostile US actions began with filing cases, obtaining legal representation, and documenting relevant evidence.

item.title: Iranian Army shoots down US LUCAS drone over Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The Army’s public relations office said the drone was struck by domestically developed air defense systems operating under the command of the Iranian integrated air defense network.

item.title: Iran will not allow ‘fake routes’ in Hormuz to replace ‘real corridors’: Leader’s advisor
item.description: A senior advisor to the Leader of the Islamic Revolution warns that fake routes cannot replace real regional corridors.

item.title: Iran FM: Enemies shifted from ‘unconditional surrender’ to ‘unconditional negotiations’
item.description: The enemy shifted from demanding 'unconditional surrender' to an 'unconditional ceasefire' during the 12-day war, and from there to 'unconditional negotiations,' Araghchi says.

item.title: Around 1,000 protest in Portugal ahead of vote on government budget
item.description: Protesters gather outside Portugal’s parliament in Lisbon as lawmakers prepare to vote on the state budget for the coming year.

item.title: Palestinians mourn victims of Israeli strikes in Gaza
item.description: Three people, including two policemen, were killed in the bombardment of a police station in Al-Mawasi in Khan Yunis.

item.title: 17 killed in airstrikes on Yemen's Hudaydah
item.description: The death toll from airstrikes on telecommunications facilities in Yemen's Red Sea port city of Hudaydah early Monday has risen to 17, al-Masirah TV reported.
